title: Intro Auto
script: An intro card sets the tone for your video. [Visual: title card]\nAuto mode generates a branded title screen. [Visual: brand logo]\nIt includes your video title and subtitle. [Visual: text overlay]

title: Outro Auto
script: An outro card encourages viewers to subscribe. [Visual: subscribe button]\nAuto mode adds a call-to-action screen. [Visual: bell icon]\nIt includes subscribe button and hashtags. [Visual: hashtag]

title: No KenBurns
script: KenBurns effect adds motion to still images. [Visual: zoom arrow]\nDisabling it keeps images completely static. [Visual: fixed frame]\nUse this for a more formal presentation style. [Visual: business]

title: No Kinetic Text
script: Kinetic text animates captions word by word. [Visual: animated text]\nDisabling it shows static caption bars. [Visual: static bar]\nUse this for a cleaner, more minimal look. [Visual: minimal design]

title: SFX Enabled
script: Sound effects add polish to transitions. [Visual: whoosh]\nSFX plays between scenes for smooth flow. [Visual: transition arrow]\nUse sparingly to avoid overwhelming viewers. [Visual: balance]
